summary.text: Gil Gatch is a Republican state representative from Dorchester County who has represented South Carolina House District 94 since 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney with Gil Gatch Law, he is first vice chairman of the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee and faces Democrat Sally Hebert in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Gil Gatch was born on June 18, 1981, in Charleston and lives in Summerville, according to the House member page and Ballotpedia.
He earned a B.A. from Southern Evangelical Seminary in 2015 and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law School in 2019.
Gatch has served in the South Carolina House of Representatives since November 2020.

The House member page lists his committee assignment as Labor, Commerce and Industry, where he is first vice chairman, and Ballotpedia lists earlier assignments to the Legislative Oversight and Education and Public Works committees.
